query_mix: current venue status and shutdown signals on Patna food corridors
Patna food creators with location and category evidence
current Patna food events with cultural/food relevance
Bihar culinary heritage sources with explicit geographic context
food discovery products emphasizing dish-level trust and temporal state

findings.statement: A current September 2026 Magicpin listing marks Chaat Guru, Exhibition Road, as shut down while still exposing older menu/review metadata.
findings.note: Single-platform status signal; do not treat as independently confirmed closure without a second source. Useful as a re-verification trigger.

findings.statement: Socialveins currently indexes Rajesh Rawani (@r_rajesh_07) in Patna under food/entertainment/home-chef categories and reports more than 2M Instagram followers.
findings.note: Third-party creator index. Follower count is an observed metric, not an editorial quality score or proof of Patna food coverage depth.

findings.statement: Bihar Saras Mela remains an active Patna food/cultural discovery signal through September 29, 2026, with traditional food among its stated offerings and approximately 135 stalls reported at Gyan Bhawan.
Eatables explicitly makes dish-level reviews, neighbourhood activity and saved must-try lists core discovery primitives, while excluding paid placements from ranking.

contradictions.statement: A venue platform can retain historical menu/review content after a place has shut down; Crave Hunt must separate historical evidence from current operational status.
Third-party creator indexes provide useful scale/location leads but cannot establish content quality, current activity, or Patna-specific food relevance by themselves.

dedupe_actions: Do not create a generic Exhibition Road place record from the Chaat Guru status page unless the venue is independently corroborated.
Keep Rajesh Rawani as a creator research lead rather than a verified Patna food authority.
Append Saras Mela as a current observation to the existing event entity rather than creating another event record.

implementation.data_change: Introduce a current-status recheck queue concept for venue records whose platform status conflicts with historical content.
implementation.product_change: Separate historical evidence from current operational state in place pages and search results.
implementation.next_ui: Evidence timeline and state badge should show when a place is active, uncertain or potentially closed, with source role visible.
